title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Two-dimensional case.
exact_target: Classify polynomially integrable natural systems on closed surfaces by their smallest integral degree, including the stated torus reductions to linear or quadratic integrals.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100301 (AMR-020-0301). CC BY 4.0.

A. Bolsinov, V. S. Matveev, E. Miranda and S. Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), arXiv:1804.03737, Problem 3.1, table, and Conjectures 3.2–3.4.
